content.description: Iteration 2: faster discharge and filtering to remove the over-long queues, stronger moto red running and early start, rarer right-lane use, slow rider archetype softened.

driver_archetypes.rationale: M1/car (sim 0.84-0.96 s vs 0.39 s) and M5/length (50-58 m vs 13 m): a smaller tau, minGap and lower sigma shorten the discharge headway so queues clear in the green; impatience 0 keeps M3/share/car near 0.003.
M1/car: a minority with tau 0.5 pulls the mean car headway towards 0.39 s; no red-running attributes because M3/share/car is about 0.003.

M4/overshoot_share (sim 0.001 vs 0.63) and M1/moto (0.52 vs 0.30 s): minimum tau/minGap/minGapLat with lcSublane 5 and high lateral standing speed let riders filter to the stop line and pack more densely, shortening headway and queue (M5/length); impatience with jmDriveAfterRedTime raises M3/share/moto (0.009 vs 0.092).

M6/approach times are already far above observed (e.g. s/moto 54-88 s vs 27 s), so the slow group is cut to 5% and speedFactor raised to 0.9 (was 0.7) to avoid blocking; it only supplies the slow lane-centre behaviour 10.
M10a/per_cycle (s00 0.21 vs 0.27) and M3/per_cycle (0.4-1.0 vs 4.4): a 10% custom1 group that can seek space and also runs the red; high impatience and jmDriveAfterRedTime raise red violations.

M7a/release_time and M7b/clear_lag: jmTimegapMinor 1.0 gave clear_lag 6.0 s (obs 6.65) and release_time 0.4 s (obs 2.6) in s03, while 1.2 gave 28 s; stay at 1.0 and use release_lag_s for the remaining gap.

traci_rules.rationale: M2/early/moto (sim 0.004-0.007 vs 0.13): most attempts ended with red before crossing, so a full 10 s window, p 0.5 and v_max 3 m/s let front-row riders actually cross early; cars excluded (M2/early/car 0.001).

M3/share/moto (0.009-0.022 vs 0.092) and M3/per_cycle (0.4-1.0 vs 4.4): earlier runs used p0 0.04-0.15 on a small share; larger p0 over the 95% moto share raises counts, k 0.08 keeps var/mean near 1.3 (M3/var_to_mean).

M9a/per_cycle (0.9-4.6 vs 0.33) and M9b/share_blocked (0.15-0.30 vs 0.02): right-lane use was far too frequent, so p_right_lane drops to 0.01; p_sidewalk 0.06 kept (M10a 0.21 vs 0.27 in s00); p_wrong_lane 0.2 follows F2 shares though redistributed on this net.
M7a/release_time (0.36 s in s03 vs 2.59 s): raise the extra release hold from 1 s to 2 s to move box exit later; M7b/clear_lag stays near the observed 6.7 s.
Behaviour 10 / M6 approach: slow riders stay at lane centre; kept for the 5% group only, with minimal effect on M4/lat_moto (sim 7.0 vs 7.085 already close).

reasoning: All it01 specs were congested (queues 50 m, approach times 3x observed, M4 overshoot ~0, M1 headway 2x). Increased discharge speed and filtering, cut the slow group, raised red running and early start, cut right-lane seeking, tuned box release.
